claim_text: Caffeine may improve selected endurance and intermittent high-intensity exercise outcomes in some adults, but response, dose, timing and adverse effects vary; performance evidence does not justify universal use.
health_goal_or_outcome: Support safe, context-specific assessment and prevent inappropriate supplementation.

population.other_context: Adults undertaking endurance or selected high-intensity sports.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Dietary and/or supplemental sources; verify product label and total exposure.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Exercise and Athletic Performance fact sheet reviews performance evidence and safety.
limitations: No protocol or dose from this claim; pregnancy, age, cardiovascular status, sleep and medications require separate assessment.
Exact source passages and underlying evidence require full appraisal before approval.
